meta.title: Apply for Life Insurance | Isaac Plans
meta.description: Start your life insurance application online — protect the people who depend on you. Secure, guided, and only a few minutes.
meta.imageAlt: Apply for life insurance with Isaac Plans

hero.title: Protect the people who depend on you
hero.subtitle: Make sure your family keeps their home and their footing if something happens to you. Start your secure application online — it only takes a few minutes.

benefits.title: A tax-free payout for your family
benefits.desc: Your beneficiaries receive the benefit income-tax free, and can use it for the mortgage, tuition, or everyday bills.

benefits.title: No medical exam options
benefits.desc: Many applicants qualify for coverage with health questions only — no lab work, no nurse visit.

benefits.title: Lock in your rate now
benefits.desc: Premiums are based on your age and health today. The younger and healthier you apply, the less you pay for good.

benefits.title: Bilingual, licensed support
benefits.desc: Get help in English or Spanish from a licensed advisor at every step.

steps.title: Open your secure application
steps.desc: Tap Apply now and your private application opens immediately — no account, no password. Come back on this device anytime to pick up where you left off.

steps.title: Fill out the secure form
steps.desc: Answer a few guided questions about your health, the coverage you want, and who you'd like to protect. Everything is encrypted and saves automatically as you go.

steps.title: We review and reach out
steps.desc: Once you submit, we shop your application across carriers and contact you with your best options.

lifeInsuranceApply.secureNote: Your information is encrypted and never shared. This process is 100% secure.
lifeInsuranceApply.ctaNote: No account or password needed — your progress saves automatically as you go.
